## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/check.py` passes (format, lint, types, tests)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, including at least one failure or edge case
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data in code, config, logs or test data
- [ ] If an answer-affecting setting changed, `config_version` is bumped in `config/default.yaml`
- [ ] If embedding or chunking settings changed, the index has been rebuilt
- [ ] README or docs updated if behaviour or commands changed
